meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: Claude 会把消息渠道接到 agent 群组上：注册新渠道、按隔离级别（同一会话、同一 agent、独立 agent）建立接线、改动已有接线，并列出当前配置。
howto.when: 在你刚添加渠道后、初始设置过程中，或想重新配置接线时触发。实例还没有 agent 群组时，它会转交 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 看下现在哪些渠道已接线、哪些还没配
say.note: 读取数据库并列出已接线、已配置未接线、未配置的渠道

say.text: 把这个 Slack 群接到已有 agent 组，用独立会话
say.note: 新建 messaging group 与 wiring 行

say.text: 把这条接线从旧 agent 组移到新组
say.note: 删除旧 wiring 记录后新建一条

howto.what_en: Claude wires messaging channels to agent groups: registering new channels, choosing an isolation level (same conversation, same agent, or separate agent), changing existing wirings, and listing the current configuration.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you add a channel, during setup, or standalone when reconfiguring. If the instance has no agent groups yet, it hands off to /init-first-agent.

say_en.text: Show which channels are wired and which aren't yet
say_en.note: Reads the DB and lists wired, configured-but-unwired, and unconfigured channels

say_en.text: Wire this Slack group to an existing agent group, separate conversations
say_en.note: Creates the messaging group and wiring rows

say_en.text: Move this wiring from the old agent group to a new one
say_en.note: Deletes the old wiring row, then creates a new one
